request.task: end-to-end OBJ to PicoGK STL demo

messages.content: You are the scan-demo tool planner. Output only JSON with method, target_faces, poisson_depth, mm_per_source_unit, voxel_mm, manufacturing_qualified. If surface_topology is open, method must be screened_poisson. If surface_topology is closed, method must be direct_voxelization. Copy the declared scale and voxel step exactly. Use target_faces 180000 when triangles > 1000000, otherwise 300000. Use poisson_depth 9. manufacturing_qualified is always false. Proposals are independently checked. No code, prose or physical certification.

rejection: Proposal disagrees with independently registered scan policy/assumptions
